s0435.zh: 从其他民族的文化中窃取文物是令人憎恶的；它不仅夺走了实物，还夺走了其创造者的尊严和精神。

it robs not only the physical objects
but the dignity and spirit of their creators

还夺走了其创造者的尊严和精神

but also the dignity and spirit of their creators

not only...but... 结构译为“不仅……还……”
their creators 指“其创造者”
s0435.en: Stealing artifacts from other peoples' cultures is obscene; it robs not only the physical objects, but the dignity and spirit of their creators.

s0658.zh: 我们正经历科学写作的黄金时代，其文字如此清晰易懂，以至于普通读者也能享受发现的不可预测性。

after examining artifacts in museums.

是在检查博物馆中的文物之后。
en_distractors: before examining artifacts in museums
without any evidence

notes that 引导宾语从句

Minson of the Harvard Kennedy School of Government concluded

depending on the situation.

concluded that 引导宾语从句

s0120.zh: 在维多利亚时代，一副闪亮、健康、整洁、整齐的“珍珠白”牙齿是罕见的景象，是超级富豪的专属（即便如此，牙齿卫生也未必有保障）。
en_chunks: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites'
was a rare sight in Victorian society,
the preserve of the super-rich
(and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed).
zh_chunks: 在维多利亚时代，
一副闪亮、健康、整洁、整齐的“珍珠白”牙齿

是超级富豪的专属

zh_distractors: 是普通人的常见景象

s0120.en: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites' was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich (and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed).

s0543.zh: 在如此高的快门速度下，景深很小，而且由于蝴蝶不是直线飞行，它们会迅速飞出焦点范围。
en_chunks: At such high shutter speeds,
the depth of field is tiny,
and as butterflies do not fly in a straight line
they swiftly flutter out of focus.
zh_chunks: 在如此高的快门速度下，
景深很小，
而且由于蝴蝶不是直线飞行，
它们会迅速飞出焦点范围。
en_distractors: At such low shutter speeds,
they slowly stay in focus
zh_distractors: 在如此低的快门速度下，
它们会缓慢地保持在焦点内
key_points: shutter speeds 翻译为“快门速度”。
depth of field 翻译为“景深”。
as 表示原因，翻译为“由于”。
flutter out of focus 翻译为“飞出焦点范围”或“失焦”。
s0543.en: At such high shutter speeds, the depth of field is tiny, and as butterflies do not fly in a straight line they swiftly flutter out of focus.

s0251.zh: 但我相信，管理良好的动物园，以及那些忍受囚禁的英勇动物，确实服务于一个更高的目的。
en_chunks: But I believe that
well-run zoos,
and the heroic animals that suffer their captivity,
do serve a higher purpose.
zh_chunks: 但我相信，
管理良好的动物园，
以及那些忍受囚禁的英勇动物，
确实服务于一个更高的目的。
en_distractors: and the animals that enjoy their freedom
do not serve any purpose
zh_distractors: 以及那些享受自由的动物
并不服务于任何目的
key_points: well-run zoos 译为“管理良好的动物园”
heroic animals that suffer their captivity 中定语从句的处理
do serve 中 do 表强调，译为“确实”
s0251.en: But I believe that well-run zoos, and the heroic animals that suffer their captivity, do serve a higher purpose.

s0495.zh: 但流媒体时代对一些意想不到的赢家来说却是一大福音：盗版者使用软件在几秒钟内从合法的在线视频平台盗录电影或电视节目，并将这些作品托管在他们自己的非法服务上，这些服务每年通过广告和订阅赚取约20亿美元。
en_chunks: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners:
pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms
and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services,
which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
zh_chunks: 但流媒体时代对一些意想不到的赢家来说却是一大福音：
盗版者使用软件在几秒钟内从合法的在线视频平台盗录电影或电视节目，
并将这些作品托管在他们自己的非法服务上，
这些服务每年通过广告和订阅赚取约20亿美元。
en_distractors: pirates that use software to create films legally
which lose about $2 billion annually
zh_distractors: 盗版者使用软件合法制作电影
这些服务每年损失约20亿美元
key_points: boon 译为“福音”
rip 在此语境下译为“盗录”
rake in 译为“赚取”
定语从句 which 指代 illegitimate services
s0495.en: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.

s0601.zh: 约翰·里思爵士说这将结束精神上的孤立，并欣喜地表示：无论有多少人在收听，总有足够的空间给其他人……天才和傻瓜，富人和穷人同时收听。
en_chunks: Sir John Reith said that
it would end isolation of the spirit
and rejoiced:
It does not matter how many thousands may be listening,
there is always enough for others...
the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously.
zh_chunks: 约翰·里思爵士说
这将结束精神上的孤立，
并欣喜地表示：
无论有多少人在收听，
总有足够的空间给其他人……
天才和傻瓜，富人和穷人同时收听。
en_distractors: it would increase isolation of the spirit
the genius and the fool listen at different times
zh_distractors: 这将加剧精神上的孤立
天才和傻瓜在不同时间收听
key_points: isolation of the spirit 译为“精神上的孤立”
rejoiced 译为“欣喜地表示”
It does not matter 译为“无论”
the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor 的并列结构
s0601.en: Sir John Reith said that it would end isolation of the spirit and rejoiced: It does not matter how many thousands may be listening, there is always enough for others... the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously.

s0502.zh: 咨询公司 Parks Associates 预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失将在未来两年内达到1130亿美元。
en_chunks: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that
legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022
will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
zh_chunks: 咨询公司 Parks Associates 预测，
自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失
将在未来两年内达到1130亿美元。
en_distractors: illegitimate US streaming services' cumulative profit
will decrease to $113 billion
zh_distractors: 美国非法流媒体服务的累计利润
将减少到1130亿美元
key_points: cumulative loss 译为“累计损失”
since 2022 与 in the next two years 的时间关系
reach 译为“达到”
s0502.en: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.

s0029.zh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式类似于社交互联网的经济：劳动力免费提供以换取地位的希望，而巨额利润则由少数经营市场的大公司赚取。
en_chunks: In some ways
the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet:
labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status,
while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
zh_chunks: 在某些方面，
科学出版模式类似于社交互联网的经济：
劳动力免费提供以换取地位的希望，
而巨额利润则由少数经营市场的大公司赚取。
en_distractors: the scientific publishing model differs from the economy
while huge losses are suffered by a few big firms
zh_distractors: 科学出版模式不同于这种经济
而巨额亏损则由少数大公司承担
key_points: resembles 译为“类似于”
in exchange for 译为“以换取”
while 表对比，译为“而”
run the market places 译为“经营市场”
s0029.en: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.

s0485.zh: 面对气候变化等棘手问题，人们很容易感到无能为力，从而什么也不做。
en_chunks: It is all too easy to feel paralysed
in the face of daunting problems such as climate change
and to do nothing.
zh_chunks: 面对气候变化等棘手问题，
人们很容易感到无能为力，
从而什么也不做。
en_distractors: It is impossible to feel motivated
and to take action
zh_distractors: 人们不可能感到有动力
从而采取行动
key_points: all too easy 译为“很容易”
paralysed 译为“无能为力”
in the face of 译为“面对”
daunting 译为“棘手的”
s0485.en: It is all too easy to feel paralysed in the face of daunting problems such as climate change and to do nothing.

s0342.zh: 在整个旅程中，杰克逊使用火棉胶湿版摄影法，同时操作多台相机和多种尺寸的感光板，该方法涉及用化学混合物涂覆感光板、曝光，并用便携式暗房冲洗所得图像。
en_chunks: Throughout the trip,
Jackson juggled multiple cameras and plate sizes
using the collodion process
that involved coating the plates with a chemical mixture,
exposing them
and developing the resulting images with a portable darkroom.
zh_chunks: 在整个旅程中，
杰克逊使用火棉胶湿版摄影法，
同时操作多台相机和多种尺寸的感光板，
该方法涉及用化学混合物涂覆感光板、
曝光，
并用便携式暗房冲洗所得图像。
en_distractors: using the digital process
and discarding the resulting images
zh_distractors: 使用数码工艺
并丢弃所得图像
key_points: juggled 译为“同时操作”
collodion process 译为“火棉胶湿版摄影法”
coating...exposing...developing 三个动名词并列
portable darkroom 译为“便携式暗房”
s0342.en: Throughout the trip, Jackson juggled multiple cameras and plate sizes using the collodion process that involved coating the plates with a chemical mixture, exposing them and developing the resulting images with a portable darkroom.

s0536.zh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶种类相对较少，其中80%正在减少，主要原因是集约化化学农业已将许多物种减少到微小的栖息地碎片和小型自然保护区。

and 80% are in decline,

and 80% are increasing
zh_distractors: 英国的蝴蝶种类相对较多
其中80%正在增加
key_points: compared with 译为“与……相比”
in decline 译为“减少”

reduced...to 译为“减少到”
s0536.en: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.

怀疑

s0169.zh: 所有这些都给试图保存重要文化物品的机构（如博物馆）带来了巨大的难题。

s0414.zh: 正如布雷特·卡瓦诺法官所观察到的，这对全美国的水质和洪水控制产生了重大影响。
en_chunks: And it carries significant repercussions
for water quality and flood control
throughout the United States,

s0393.zh: 一个出生于狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能拥有超过十位照顾者——这与英国的托儿所环境形成鲜明对比，英国的规定要求两到三岁儿童与看护人的比例为四比一。
en_chunks: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society
could have more than ten caregivers—
this contrasts starkly to nursery settings in the UK
where regulations call for a ratio of one carer to four children
aged two to three.
zh_chunks: 一个出生于狩猎采集社会的婴儿
可能拥有超过十位照顾者——

英国的规定要求两到三岁儿童与看护人的比例为四比一。

一个出生于狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能拥有超过十位照顾者——这与英国的托儿所环境形成鲜明对比，英国的规定要求两到三岁儿童与看护人的比例为三比一。

s0309.zh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来提供思想接触、选择和不同的声音。

in terms of authors and staff

of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.

关注的是作者和员工，

in terms of authors and staff and readers

出版业在谈论多样性时，关注的是作者和员工，但它也需要多种方式来提供思想接触、选择和不同的观点。

s0596.zh: 我们靠电视高峰期的繁荣维持生计，这种繁荣是流媒体服务爆炸式增长所要求的大量内容。

the glut of content

the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services and cable

我们靠电视高峰期的繁荣维持生计，这种繁荣是流媒体服务爆炸式增长所要求的海量内容。

s0007.zh: 愤世嫉俗者可能会推测，英国正处于消失于无休止的自我庆祝狂热之中的边缘，因为它拼命想在后脱欧世界中重塑自我：继文化之城后，谁知道接下来会是什么——文化之村？

他们在很大程度上定义了该院系的学术生活规范
en_distractors: When a faculty or department grows from, say, five to 20 members within ten years

zh_distractors: 当一个院系或系部在十年内从五名成员增加到二十名
并且新员工主要是刚完成研究生学习的年长男女时
key_points: When引导时间状语从句，两个when并列
say作插入语，意为比如说
fresh from意为刚从...来

s0157.en: When a faculty or department grows from, say, five to 20 members within three or four years, and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty.

s0503.zh: 尽管有一些乐观情绪认为，新兴的对策和最佳实践可能会使盗版到2027年开始趋于平稳，但利益相关者之间对于何时可能开始下降尚未达成共识，分析师史蒂夫·霍利说。

there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline

s0503.en: While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline, says analyst Steve Hawley.

s0056.zh: 这些单方面的事态发展在具体细节上有所不同，但它们都旨在对跨国公司的收入和营收征税，这些国家认为他们有权对此征税，即使国际税收规则并未授予他们这一权利。

but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue
that countries believe they should have a right to tax
even if international tax rules do not grant them that right

but they are all designed to tax multinationals on profits
zh_distractors: 这些单方面的事态发展在目标上有所不同
但它们都旨在对跨国公司的利润征税
key_points: differ in意为在...方面不同

that引导定语从句修饰income and revenue

s0056.en: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.

s0394.zh: 研究人员表示，虽然狩猎采集者的儿童在混合年龄的游戏群体中通过观察和模仿学习，但西方的指导性教学（要求学生静坐）可能会导致注意力缺陷多动障碍等状况。

zh_chunks: 研究人员表示
虽然狩猎采集者的儿童在混合年龄的游戏群体中通过观察和模仿学习
但西方的指导性教学
要求学生静坐
可能会导致注意力缺陷多动障碍等状况

s0453.zh: 一种可能性是，它们仅仅用眼睛观察并尝试找到的植物，但那很可能会导致大量时间和精力的浪费，尤其是因为它们的视力实际上并不很好。

s0592.zh: 如果这听起来像戏剧化的夸张，请考虑以下事实：艺术指导工会——一个代表约3000名电影工作人员的劳工组织——已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发表声明解释说，我们无法凭良心鼓励你们追求我们的职业。

s0537.zh: 蝴蝶授粉的植物数量可能不如野生蜜蜂和食蚜蝇多，但由于英国的蝴蝶是世界上研究最深入的昆虫群体，它们成为飞行昆虫更广泛减少的一个极其有用的指标。

but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world,

en_distractors: butterflies pollinate more plants than wild bees
they are a useless indicator of insect declines
zh_distractors: 蝴蝶授粉的植物比野生蜜蜂多

key_points: pollinate 译为“授粉”
best-studied 译为“研究最深入的”
indicator 译为“指标”
s0537.en: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants as wild bees and hoverflies, but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world, they are an extremely useful indicator of the wider declines in flying insects.

s0450.zh: 研究人员确信，大象总是精确地知道它们相对于所需所有资源的位置，因此可以走捷径，也能沿着熟悉的路线行走。

take shortcuts 译为“走捷径”
as well as 连接并列成分，译为“也”
s0450.en: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.

s0356.zh: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点是，人们担心将个人互动交给机器，这不仅可能导致人际联系的后续丧失，还可能导致营销人员的减少。

人们担心将个人互动交给机器

zh_distractors: 使用人工智能有好处

key_points: disadvantage 译为“缺点”
trusting personal interactions to machines 译为“将个人互动交给机器”
not only...but also 译为“不仅……而且”
s0356.en: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.

s0363.zh: 可以收集关于客户可能被接触的位置的数据，例如地点、使用的设备、网站互动和访问的网站，以适当的形式显示营销信息，包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹出广告和横幅，并以适当的频率显示。

s0072.zh: 一个更直接的发现是，那些在焦虑等负面情绪上得分高的人看别人的时间较短，并且在别人不直接看他们时报告了更舒适的感觉。

s0077.zh: 在科学与宗教思想高度紧张时期提出这样一个理论被斥为异端，任何继续传播这些谎言的异端者都将受到监禁甚至死亡的惩罚。

s0486.zh: 认识到科学和工程能够带来的希望，是设立千年技术奖背后的推动力，该奖项如今已进入第20个年头，作为对人类创造力的庆祝。

s0047.zh: 下次有人推动企业配额作为促进性别平等的方式时，请记住，这类政策在很大程度上是自私自利的措施，让推行者自我感觉良好，但对普通女性帮助甚微。

zh_chunks: 下次有人推动企业配额作为促进性别平等的方式时

a system that was later upheld by Galileo at his own benefit
zh_distractors: 认为我们所知道的所有行星绕地球运行，而非绕太阳运行
这一体系后来被伽利略以自身利益所维护
key_points: theorized 后接 that 宾语从句
not...but... 结构，意为“不是……而是……”
a system 为同位语，指代前面的理论
at his own expense 意为“以自身代价”
s0076.en: Copernicus theorized in 1543 that all of the planets that we knew of revolved not around the Earth, but the Sun, a system that was later upheld by Galileo at his own expense.

s0617.zh: 今天我们为盯着智能手机和自拍虚荣的孤立文化而烦恼，但在1939年就已经有那位女士遗憾地说，当她整条街都装上无线电时，人们失去了在刷子柄上交谈的邻里习惯。
en_chunks: Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity
but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how
when all her street got wirelesses
it lost the neighbourly habit of talking on the brush handle
zh_chunks: 今天我们为盯着智能手机和自拍虚荣的孤立文化而烦恼
但在1939年就已经有那位女士遗憾地说
当她整条街都装上无线电时
人们失去了在刷子柄上交谈的邻里习惯
en_distractors: Today we fret about the connecting culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity
when all her street got televisions
zh_distractors: 今天我们为盯着智能手机和自拍虚荣的联结文化而烦恼
当她整条街都装上电视时
key_points: fret about 意为“为……烦恼”
regretting how 后接宾语从句，how 引导方式
wirelesses 指“无线电收音机”
talking on the brush handle 指旧时电话的听筒挂在刷子柄上，引申为邻里交谈
s0617.en: Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity, but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how, when all her street got wirelesses, it lost the neighbourly habit of talking on the brush handle.

s0374.zh: 根据西切尔的说法，尽管钉子价格下降部分是由更便宜的钢铁和更便宜的能源驱动的，但大部分功劳归于钉子制造商，他们只是找到了更有效的方法将钢转化为钉子。
en_chunks: According to Sichel
although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy
most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers
who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails
zh_chunks: 根据西切尔的说法
尽管钉子价格下降部分是由更便宜的钢铁和更便宜的能源驱动的
但大部分功劳归于钉子制造商
他们只是找到了更有效的方法将钢转化为钉子
en_distractors: although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper labor
who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into wires
zh_distractors: 尽管钉子价格下降部分是由更便宜的钢铁和更便宜的劳动力驱动的
他们只是找到了更有效的方法将钢转化为铁丝
key_points: According to 意为“根据”
although 引导让步状语从句
credit goes to 意为“功劳归于”
who 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 manufacturers
s0374.en: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.

s0097.zh: 是的，需要更多投资，但如果乘客还必须忍受拥挤、不可靠的服务，并因时刻表变更或计划维护管理不善而时常中断，他们不会愿意无限期地支付更多费用。
en_chunks: Yes, more investment is needed
but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely
if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services
interrupted by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently
zh_chunks: 是的，需要更多投资
但如果乘客还必须忍受拥挤、不可靠的服务
他们不会愿意无限期地支付更多费用
并因时刻表变更或计划维护管理不善而时常中断
en_distractors: but passengers will be willing to pay more indefinitely
interrupted by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed competently
zh_distractors: 但乘客会愿意无限期地支付更多费用
并因时刻表变更或计划维护管理得当而时常中断
key_points: not...if... 结构，条件状语从句
endure cramped, unreliable services 中 cramped 和 unreliable 并列修饰 services
interrupted by... 为过去分词短语作定语修饰 services
when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently 中 or 连接两个并列时间状语从句
s0097.en: Yes, more investment is needed, but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services, interrupted by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently.

s0021.zh: Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的副本，这表明法律生态系统在其用户中已失去合法性，必须进行改革，使其为所有参与者服务。
en_chunks: The success of Sci-Hub
which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed
shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users
and must be transformed so that it works for all participants
zh_chunks: Sci-Hub的成功
依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的副本
这表明法律生态系统在其用户中已失去合法性
并且必须进行改革，使其为所有参与者服务
en_distractors: which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves illegally accessed
shows the legal ecosystem has gained legitimacy among its users
zh_distractors: 依赖于研究人员传递他们自己非法获取的副本
这表明法律生态系统在其用户中已获得合法性
key_points: which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 Sci-Hub
passing on 意为“传递”
they have themselves legally accessed 为定语从句修饰 copies
so that 引导目的状语从句
s0021.en: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.

s0121.zh: 即使是马克·吐温，一个喜欢开怀大笑的人，也说在摄影肖像方面，没有什么比一个愚蠢、傻笑永远定格更糟糕的了。
en_chunks: Even Mark Twain
a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh
said that when it came to photographic portraits
there could be nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever
zh_chunks: 即使是马克·吐温
一个喜欢开怀大笑的人
也说在摄影肖像方面
没有什么比一个愚蠢、傻笑永远定格更糟糕的了
en_distractors: a man who disliked a hearty laugh
there could be something more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever
zh_distractors: 一个不喜欢开怀大笑的人
有什么比一个愚蠢、傻笑永远定格更糟糕的
key_points: Even 强调，意为“即使”
a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh 为同位语，解释 Mark Twain
when it came to 意为“当谈到”
nothing more damning than 意为“没有比……更糟糕的”
s0121.en: Even Mark Twain, a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh, said that when it came to photographic portraits there could be nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever.

s0280.zh: 德克萨斯自由网络的高级通讯策略师丹·奎因说，像她这样的董事会成员随意地将学者和科学家的职业工作贬低为仅仅是另一种错误的观点，该网络是一个监督公共教育的非营利组织。
en_chunks: Board members like her casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists
as just another misguided opinion,
says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network,
a non-profit group that monitors public education.
zh_chunks: 德克萨斯自由网络的高级通讯策略师丹·奎因说，
像她这样的董事会成员随意地将学者和科学家的职业工作
贬低为仅仅是另一种错误的观点，
该网络是一个监督公共教育的非营利组织。
en_distractors: as just another correct opinion,
a for-profit group that monitors public education.
zh_distractors: 贬低为仅仅是另一种正确的观点，
该网络是一个监督公共教育的营利组织。
key_points: casually dismiss 的翻译，体现随意贬低的态度
career work 指职业工作，需准确传达
Dan Quinn 的身份和机构名称的翻译
非限制性定语从句 a non-profit group... 的翻译处理
s0280.en: Board members like her casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion, says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.

s0300.zh: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，Waterstones 的分店经理被告知要将 PRH 的书籍从显眼位置（如桌子、展示空间和橱窗）移除，并悄悄地将它们放回相应的区域。
en_chunks: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported
that Waterstones branch managers were being told
to remove PRH books from prominent areas
such as tables, display spaces and windows,
and were quietly retiring them to their relevant sections.
zh_chunks: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，
Waterstones 的分店经理被告知
要将 PRH 的书籍从显眼位置移除，
如桌子、展示空间和橱窗，
并悄悄地将它们放回相应的区域。
en_distractors: to remove PRH books from hidden areas
and were loudly retiring them to their relevant sections.
zh_distractors: 要将 PRH 的书籍从隐蔽位置移除，
并大声地将它们放回相应的区域。
key_points: trade magazine 译为行业杂志
prominent areas 指显眼位置，需准确翻译
quietly retiring 体现悄悄处理，注意语气
such as 列举的翻译处理
s0300.en: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were quietly retiring them to their relevant sections.

s0316.zh: 2016年，研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式，包括不成比例地相互引用的作者群体，以及频繁相互引用以提高其出版物影响因子的期刊群体。
en_chunks: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm
to recognize suspicious citation patterns,
including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another
and groups of journals that cite each other frequently
to increase the impact factors of their publications.
zh_chunks: 2016年，研究人员开发了一种算法
来识别可疑的引用模式，
包括不成比例地相互引用的作者群体，
以及频繁相互引用的期刊群体，
以提高其出版物影响因子。
en_distractors: to recognize normal citation patterns,
and groups of journals that cite each other rarely
zh_distractors: 来识别正常的引用模式，
以及很少相互引用的期刊群体
key_points: suspicious citation patterns 译为可疑的引用模式
disproportionately cite one another 的翻译，体现不成比例
impact factors 译为影响因子
长句的拆分与语序调整
s0316.en: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.

s0667.zh: 尽管这些努力针对的是不打算学理科的学生，但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共话语，作为一种为学校科学教学重要性争取广泛支持的手段。
en_chunks: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student,
they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse
as a means to rally widespread support
for the importance of science teaching in schools.
zh_chunks: 尽管这些努力针对的是不打算学理科的学生，
但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共话语，
作为一种争取广泛支持的手段，
为学校科学教学的重要性。

as a means to rally limited support
zh_distractors: 尽管这些努力针对的是打算学理科的学生，
作为一种争取有限支持的手段
key_points: nonscience-bound student 的翻译，指不打算学理科的学生
made their way into 的翻译，体现进入
rally widespread support 译为争取广泛支持
as a means to 的翻译处理
s0667.en: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student, they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse as a means to rally widespread support for the importance of science teaching in schools.

s0446.zh: 它们有时会走六十多英里去找食物或水，而且非常擅长判断其他大象在哪里——即使它们不在视线范围内。
en_chunks: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles
to find food or water,
and are very good at working out where other elephants are
—even when they are out of sight.
zh_chunks: 它们有时会走六十多英里
去找食物或水，
而且非常擅长判断其他大象在哪里
——即使它们不在视线范围内。
en_distractors: They sometimes travel less than sixty miles
and are very bad at working out where other elephants are
zh_distractors: 它们有时会走不到六十英里
而且非常不擅长判断其他大象在哪里
key_points: travel more than sixty miles 的翻译
working out 译为判断、弄清楚
out of sight 译为不在视线范围内
破折号的处理
s0446.en: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight.

s0052.zh: 但这已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表开始调查该税是否歧视美国公司，这反过来可能导致对法国的贸易制裁。
en_chunks: But it has already sparked significant controversy,

美国贸易代表开始调查
该税是否歧视美国公司，

which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against Germany.
zh_distractors: 但这已经引发了轻微争议，

with 结构表伴随，翻译为美国贸易代表开始调查

which in turn 译为这反过来
s0052.en: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in tum could lead to trade sanctions against France.

s0267.zh: 它列出了许多从西班牙法军中缴获的密码文件，这些文件的秘密是由英国总部的一名军官乔治·斯科维尔的工作揭示的。

zh_chunks: 它列出了许多密码文件，
这些文件是从西班牙法军中缴获的，
其秘密是由乔治·斯科维尔的工作揭示的，

an officer in French headquarters.

captured from the French army of Spain 的翻译，注意军队归属
whose secrets 的翻译，处理定语从句
one George Scovell 的翻译，体现一位
s0267.en: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.

s0675.zh: 回归到那种科学素养版本，它更侧重于教授科学是什么以及科学如何运作，而不是记忆科学事实，这似乎是当今社会迫切需要的东西。
en_chunks: A return to that version of scientific literacy,
which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works

seems like something society today desperately needs.
zh_chunks: 回归到那种科学素养版本，
它更侧重于教授科学是什么以及科学如何运作，
而不是记忆科学事实，
这似乎是当今社会迫切需要的东西。
en_distractors: A return to that version of scientific literacy,
which focused less on teaching what science is and how it works
zh_distractors: 回归到那种科学素养版本，
它更侧重于记忆科学事实
key_points: scientific literacy 译为科学素养
focused more on... and less on... 的翻译，体现对比
desperately needs 译为迫切需要
定语从句的翻译处理
s0675.en: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.

s0511.zh: 在创作之时，没有人试图进行有意的保存，然而模拟材料有机会幸存下来，并作为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
en_chunks: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation,
yet analog materials have a chance of surviving
and serving as the historical record
that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
zh_chunks: 在创作之时，没有人试图进行有意的保存，

并作为历史记录，

that biographers, historians, and novelists ignore.
zh_distractors: 在创作之时，许多人试图进行有意的保存，
这些记录是传记作者、历史学家和小说家所忽视的。
key_points: intentional preservation 译为有意的保存
analog materials 译为模拟材料
serving as 译为作为
定语从句 that... rely on 的翻译

s0676.zh: 教育工作者提出了让学生在高中完成详细实验室练习的想法，认为这类工作主要有利于提高逻辑推理和观察能力。

of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools
in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily
as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.
zh_chunks: 教育工作者提出了这个想法，
让学生在高中完成详细的实验室练习，
认为这类工作主要是有益的，
作为提高逻辑推理和观察能力的一种方式。

as a way to diminish logical reasoning and observational skills.
zh_distractors: 教育工作者否定了这个想法，

in the belief that 译为认为
beneficial primarily 译为主要是有益的
enhance logical reasoning and observational skills 的翻译
s0676.en: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.

s0285.zh: Branch指出，即使越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了关于气候变化的科学共识，但传达更片面观点的非官方教材正在被分发给教师。

are being distributed to teachers.

即使越来越多的官方指南和教科书

正在被分发给教师和学生

被动语态 are being distributed 译为“正在被分发”
s0285.en: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.

s0089.zh: 历届政府都允许这样的增长，理由是投资和运营铁路网络的成本应该由使用它的人承担，而不是普通纳税人。

s0224.zh: 如果不使工作面临风险，在就业保护法限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理者的程度上，这些法律限制了企业生产率，从而限制了工人的工资。
en_chunks: If not placing jobs at risk,
to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers,
those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity
and therefore on workers' wages.
zh_chunks: 如果不使工作面临风险，
在就业保护法限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理者的程度上，
这些法律限制了企业生产率，

those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and workers' wages

s0224.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.

s0434.zh: 话虽如此，我确实觉得，任何进入公共博物馆的文物，事实上都应该被认可为是通过借展、合法购买或通过条约获得的。

should be considered as having been obtained by loan or purchase

s0630.zh: 在他的牛津讲座中，谢默斯·希尼认为，一首诗描绘了一幅现实的图画，一个瞥见的替代方案，它以或大或小的方式与你的现实形成矛盾。

a poem draws a picture of reality,

s0418.zh: 将这些法院裁决仅仅视为维护土地所有者的权利，是过于简单且具有误导性的，因为其后果对邻居来说可能如此严重。

s0099.zh: 2007年，印度尼西亚开始逐步实施一项计划，该计划在特定条件下向其最贫困居民提供资金，例如要求人们让孩子上学或定期接受医疗保健。

zh_distractors: 该计划在特定条件下向其最富裕居民征收资金

key_points: phase in 的翻译
that 引导的定语从句

s0099.en: In 2007, Indonesia started phasing in a program that gives money to its poorest residents under certain conditions, such as requiring people to keep kids in school or get regular medical care.

s0420.zh: 我们可以让他们参观位于多切斯特县的黑水国家野生动物保护区，在那里，秃鹰飞越潮汐沼泽，这些沼泽非常浅，你无法划船穿过，但充满水生生物。

但充满水生生物

so deep you could not wade across them but lacking aquatic life

s0048.zh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对在法国向消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税。

s0521.zh: 如果没有数字资产的持续迁移，一个关于可预见未来的噩梦就是让历史学家夜不能寐的事情：当数字取代模拟时，历史记录会突然停止。
